FROM THE INFORMATION OFFICE

GERALD WRIGHT DIRECTOR 


7 SGWU HONORS 
FACULTY, STAFF, & GOVERNORS 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


METROPOLITAN YMCA 
OF MONTREAL 


April 5th, 1963 


THIRTY MONTREALERS WILL BE HONORED THIS WEEKEND BY 
SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY AT A SPECIAL DINNER 
TO BE HELD SATURDAY, APRIL 6TH AT THE UNIVERSITY. 


THOSE TO BE HONORED INCLUDE GOVERNORS, FACULTY AND 
STAFF WHO HAVE SERVED THE UNIVERSITY FOR OVER 20 
YEARS. 


AMONG THOSE TO BE HONORED ARE MISS IVA MUIR WHO CAME 

TO TEACH PITMAN SHORTHAND AT THE SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
SCHOOL IN 1916 AND WHO STILL TEACHES 5 DAYS A WEEK AND 

2 NIGHTS IN THE SAME SUBJECT. NELSON ELLIOTT, DIRECTOR 

OF THE BUSINESS SCHOOL AND MR. GEORGE FLANAGAN BOTH JOINED 
THE STAFF OF THE YMCA BUSINESS SCHOOL IN 1919. 


OTHERS TO BE HONOURED INCLUDE DR. J. W. BRIDGES, NOTED 
INTERNATIONAL PSYCHOLOGIST, OR. HERBERT F. QUINN, POLITICAL 
SCIENTIST AND NOTED AUTHORITY ON FRENCH POLITICAL AFFAIRS, 
AND DR. H. Fe. HALL, PRINCIPAL EMERITUS. AMONG THE CITIZENS 
TO BE HONORED FOR THEIR LONG VOLUNTARY SERVICE TO THE UNIV- 
ERS!ITY AND TO THE COMMUNITY, ARE J. B. FROSST, A GOVERNOR 
AND B. W. ROBERTS, THE CHANCELLOR. 


CONT EHUC <6. Se 6 


PAGE 2 


PRINCIPAL ROBERT CANON RAE WILL PRESIDE, DR. H. F. HALL 
WILL BE THE SPEAKER, AND PROFESSOR JAMES WHITELAW WILL 
PROPOSE A TOAST OF HONOR TO THE GUESTS. CERTIFICATES OF 
OF RECOGNITION AND APPRECIATION WILL BE PRESENTED TO EACH 


HONORED GUEST.*
